title: Veerani
body:
veerani
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ko aur rulaye
veeran gharon ki veerani
<<DIVIDER>>
chalees gharon mein jaa jaa kar
kis kis ka sog manaye
veerani
zainab ko aur rulaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aangan mein umme salma
sughra ke aansu poche
dil par apne pathar rakh kar
bibi se aa kar bole
sughra uth jaa in raston se
ab koi nahi jo aaye
veerani
zainab ko aur rulaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aangan mein asghar ke liye
jalti hay dhoop mein dukhiya
ghar bhar ki nazar hai suraj par
kab waqt ghuroob ka hoga
aur maadar ko ye fikr hai ke
ye suraj doob na jaye
veerani
zainab ko aur rulaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aangan mein bemaar pisar
aankhon se khoon bahaye
bazaron ka har ek manzar
ashkon mein dhalta jaye
sajjad bohat saabir hai magar
ab kitna sabr dikhaye
veerani
zainab ko aur rulaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aangan mein fizza baithi
har lamha ye hi soche
jaa kar zehra ki turbat par
kya baat kaneez ye bole
kaise zainab darbar gayi
kya zehra ko batlaye
veerani
zainab ko aur rulaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aangan mein baithi hai maa
yaseen ka surah khole
wo zikre nabi ke lafzon mein
humshakle nabi ko dhoonde
rauze pe nabi ke aa jaye
jab yaad akbar ki aaye
veerani
zainab ko aur rulaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aangan mein abdullah aur
zainab baithe hai tanha
wo aun o mohamed ke gham mein
ek doosre ko de pursa
de daad pidar har hamle par
jab maadar jang sunaye
veerani
zainab ko aur rulaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal tak akbar ek zehra thi
jo bain kiya karti thi
baba ki judaai ke gham mein
wo aahein bhara karti thi
aur aaj bani hashim ke makaan
sab baitul huzn hai haye
veerani
zainab ko aur rulaye...
author: Hasnain Akbar
